title: Lazar only went to the base five or six times

tellings.quote: my understanding through Tim Good who had interviewed him at the time was that he only been at the base five or six times.

plain: Bob Lazar is a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site called S-4 in the Nevada desert in 1988 and 1989. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that Tim Good, an author who interviewed Lazar back then, understood that Lazar had only been to the base five or six times, a point Cameron ties to Lazar's 1988 W-2, the US tax form that shows wages paid by an employer. It matters because it bears on how much Lazar could really have seen.
